note: The tabnas runtime dependencies the ports of c do not share, with why and what repairs each. tools/port-deps.cjs reads it; ADR-24 in tabnas/admin DECISIONS.md.

expr.reason: From 0.6 C's expressions are its own grammar rules (docs/rules.md), and the TypeScript and Go readers no longer install @tabnas/expr: the Go module no longer imports it, while ts/package.json and rs/Cargo.toml still declare it (the Rust reader still installs it until it moves to the rules).
expr.repair: Once the Rust reader moves to the rules, the maintainer removes the dependency from ts/package.json, rs/Cargo.toml and go/go.mod (a dependency change, ADR-22).
